sections.intro: This guide helps the instructor use the GEOPÓLEM teaching materials with real cases from the v1 contract.
sections.objectives: By the end, learners will be able to build and validate causal links backed by verified sources.
sections.session_flow: 1) Case context, 2) reading the fiche, 3) building the causal matrix, 4) rubric assessment, 5) feedback by band.
sections.assessment: Use the canonical rubrics; scoring is aggregated and anonymous, with no real grades or identities.
sections.sources_policy: Every causal claim must cite verified (non-demo) sources; if missing, flag the field as pending.
sections.anonymity_policy: Do not collect learners' personal data; assessments must be anonymous or synthetic.
